leftEvidence.title: Zipporah acts during a lethal encounter

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: At a lodging place the LORD meets “him” and seeks his death; Zipporah circumcises her son and touches the foreskin to “his feet.”
points.right: The LORD sends Aaron to meet Moses; Moses reports the words and signs, and the brothers gather Israel’s elders.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Zipporah speaks of a bridegroom of blood, and the threat is released after her action and words.
points.right: Aaron speaks and performs the signs; the people believe, bow, and worship when they hear that the LORD has seen their affliction.

payload.posture: The threat ceases and the narrative immediately returns to Aaron, the signs, the elders, and Israel’s response.

rightEvidence.title: Aaron meets Moses and the people believe

payload.tension: Continuation shows that the crisis is over but does not explain why it occurred.
payload.title: The interruption and the resumed mission
